articles.summary: WILMINGTON, N.C., Sept. 14, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Live Oak Bank has been named the Official Business Bank of UNCW Athletics under a multi-year agreement, expanding a relationship that already includes title sponsorship of the Live Oak Bank Holiday Classic men's basketball tournament. The agreement gives Live Oak year-round presence across Seahawk athletics, including men’s and women’s basketball at Trask Coliseum and baseball at Brooks Field. UNCW has been a talent pipeline for Live Oak for years, with more than 200 alumni employed at the bank. The bank is a consistent participant in Business Week at the Cameron School of Business, and its employees regularly mentor and volunteer across the university. "Live Oak is Wilmington’s hometown bank, and UNCW is a significant part of what makes this city a place where businesses can thrive," said William C. (BJ) Losch III, president of Live Oak. articles.title: Live Oak Bank Named Official Business Bank of UNCW Athletics
